newsitem.title: USA: Michael Anthony Jewelers, Andin to merge.
newsitem.headline: Michael Anthony Jewelers, Andin to merge.

text.p: Michael Anthony Jewelers Inc and Andin International Inc have signed a preliminary letter of intent to merge in a deal valued at $70 million, the companies said on Friday.
The combination will create one of the largest worldwide marketers and manufacturers of fine jewelry with pro forma annual sales of more than $280 million, the companies said in a joint statement.
Michael Anthony will pay Andin $10 million in cash, $10 million in a 7.5 percent subordinated note and 1.7 million shares of Michael Anthony common stock, the companies said.
Shares of Michael Anthony on Friday closed at $3.25.
Michael Anthony will also assume all $45 million of Andin's debt, the companies said.
Also, contingent warrants to purchase 2,200,000 shares of common stock at an exercise price of $4.55 each will be attached to the note, the companies said.
Andin had sales of more than $130 million in 1996, while Michael Anthony's sales of $150.6 million for the year ended February 1.
